liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Maybe You Know** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Brent struggles to find the chords for about five minutes before singing, while the drummers wait for him; Brent stayed out during drums and played this with only the drummers and Jose Lorenzo; Jerry came out at the end [1][9][10][13][14]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review, 1 other source): Jerry followed with a great version after the Goin' Down the Road; The first ten seconds are patched, using a source provided by David Gans [2][10]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Jerry went straight into it after Maybe You Know, skipping the drum solo and space section [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd86-04-21 01 Crowd Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-21 02 Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-21 03 El Paso**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-21 04 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-21 05 My Brother Esau**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-21 06 Cumberland Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-21 07 Desolation Row**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd86-04-21 08 Ramble On Rose**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-04-21.140223.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 146 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd.miller.34765.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 139 min; rated 3.12/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd86-04-21.sbd.jeffm.1857.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 2.79/5 by 62 [4]. Said about its sound: Has static and an odd, noticeable cut without a blank spot; not mentioned in the text file; Listener hears a strange voice-like sound during the Drums Keys Jam and wonders if it was added [15][17]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd-pcm.miller.34766.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 145 min; rated 2/5 by 4 [3]

## Around the show

- Brent's singing is off-key all night and his playing erratic, suggesting he was impaired, tired or depressed [9]
- Jerry came out to salvage the second set, followed by Phil, then Bobby running out from backstage [11]
- After the show, Brent had to be helped into the back seat of a Sausalito limo [11]
- The reviewer read about this show in the book Long Strange Trip; says the rest of the show is pretty solid [12]
- The show was a Rex benefit; Jose Lorenzo joined on drums [1]
- Rex benefit show; Jose Lorenzo joined for Eyes and Drums, and Maybe You Know was without Jerry and Phil [4]
- Reviewer says the rest of the show is not that bad, apart from Maybe You Know [14]
- Reviewer says the worst version of any song would be any My Brother Esau, not this Maybe You Know [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-04-21.140223.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Charlie Miller, Jim Wise, Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 (110 degree ORTF)> Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown deck/hardware/software) > hard disk >… [1]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd.miller.34765.flac16**: taped by Thanks to Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for the Cassettes; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) D [2]. Also: Soundboard transferred from cassettes via PCM and DAT, edited in Samplitude Professional 7.02, using a Nak cassette deck [2]
- **gd86-04-21.sbd.jeffm.1857.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Master Cassette> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN [4]
- **gd1986-04-21.sbd-pcm.miller.34766.flac16**: transferred by David Gans and Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> PCM -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD; Set 2: SBD -> PCM -> Dat [3]
